reference: Mi-24A: common 'greenhouse' cockpit, navigator-operator in the nose with basic flight controls and the sight for the Falanga missiles / A-12.7 gun, pilot behind on the model's offset (left) seat with the flight engineer's station on his right; pilot steam panel, centre cyclic, collective, two engine levers, PKV collimator sight.
